Episode 229: The Safeguard of Kelliark (1)
On February 25, 1804, Dokmaseong.
"Groshe Castle has fallen."
Gulp...
Kelliark filled his tea cup and spoke. He glanced around at the Demon Kings seated before him, shielding his eyes from the pale light of the artificial sun coming through the window.
Ragal Phun, Leila Belgasium, Reldro Trinac, Seph Mogreles.
While the alliance was attacking Groshe Castle, Kelliark had gathered the remaining Demon Kings in hell.
"No matter what, I never thought the end would come so quickly... Really, just as you said, my friend Kelliark. Even with Sakiel, that idiot, using the Field of Loss, what a disgrace!"
"Sakiel did her best and made the most appropriate judgment in the situation by utilizing all the means she had. It's just that the enemy was stronger. Is there any reason to insult her?"

"Oh, yes, sorry, Leila. I spoke out of line. I really can't get along with her. Did I really insult Sakiel that much? I was just disappointed that she couldn't deal any damage to them, even after spreading the Field of Loss. Isn't that right, friend Kelliark?"
Leila has not yet fully recovered her memory of her relationship with Sakiel.
However, for some reason, it felt unpleasant to insult her. Even if it wasn't about a forgotten memory, Sakiel, as the Secretary-General, was definitely a superior talent compared to Ragal.

"Your words are correct as are Leila's. It would have been nice if Sakiel had dealt even a little damage to the alliance. But the only ones who suffered from the Field of Loss and Yeokcheon were the family that Kinzelo and I have to recover."

"Damn it! That bastard Zito! I can't stand the fact that I've been brainwashed and served him for so long. While so many demons were dying in the attack by the alliance, Zito did not provide any support. How could he do that!"
Reldro clenched his fist and shouted. Seph, who was sitting next to him, had a distorted face with anger towards Zito.

"... As you said, Sir Kelliark, and according to our recalled memories. What Zito wants is not the victory or prosperity of the Demon World. That monster wants only more pain. His subordinates who sacrifice their lives to protect the Demon World? Do you think Zito would even care a little about them? We were no different than Zito until we realized the truth with the help of Sir Kelliark."

"Hey, don't say that we were no different. What are you talking about, Seph? We were victims because we lost our taste due to brainwashing. Oh, damn it! Why are my eyes getting moist again. Don't cry, it's not like you. We just need to take revenge, revenge."

Ragal's loyalty was now far deeper towards Kelliark than Zito. He had finished weighing his internal scales. Another layer of brainwashing had been peeled off, and he was impressed by the abilities Kelliark had shown so far.

"Lord Kelliark, with the fall of Groshe Castle, the human forces will soon enter hell. It will take a few days due to the remnants of magic and mana left on the battlefield as the Field of Loss collapses, but it won't take long. There are no forces left in the human world capable of stopping them."
At Raila's words, Kelliark nodded. She too had grown to respect Kelliark far more than when they first met.

"Jin Runcandel is a cautious person. So, even if the remnants left by the Field of Loss disappear, he will not immediately enter hell. As soon as the remnants disappear, Jin will scrutinize all the records left on the battlefield using Valeria Hister. He'll want to check if there are any internal information in the records."
Kelliark turned his gaze to Ragal.
"He may have figured out by now that you and I have joined hands."
"Hmm, he could have noticed my sloppy fighting, but did he really rummage through all the records of that chaotic defense line?"

"It's quite possible. That's why our family has always tried to eliminate the record mages. My biggest mistake when I was the head of the Zipple family wasn't the unexpected betrayal from my son. It was handing over the record mage to Jin Runcandel."
"So, is it that serious? A record mage."
"Yes... Even if the magic of the Field of Loss was fully expanded, it may not have threatened Jin if Valeria Hister had mastered record magic."
Kelliark sincerely believed this.
Perhaps not just the Field of Loss, but even if the 'Mashin Stone' was completed, it might not damage the record magic at its peak.

"There are three more reasons why Jin Runcandel won't enter hell directly. Zipple and Kinzelo need time for restructuring. They gathered to defeat a common enemy, but Vamel Alliance has yet to suffer any significant damage, so there's no need to rush into hell alone."
"Listening to you, friend Kelliark, you're right! Then, what's the last one? Ah, no, I'm a demon who thinks... I want to guess once. Um, uh. It's... it's right! The Holy Land, Zito's eyes!"
Kelliark nodded.
Raila's eyes widened in surprise. She couldn't believe that Ragal had this level of intelligence even after seeing it firsthand.

"Zito will definitely regain his eyes before humans enter the Demon Realm. Of course, Zito is already madly strong, but if he regains his eyes, there won't be any variables. From then on, he probably won't care about Helrum? And then, the freedom granted to our friend Kelliark by Zito will come to an end....."
"Kelliark's freedom ends." Ragar thought that if that happened, everyone gathered here would die.

'So far, it seems that Zito is deliberately not looking at Kelliark because of the witch... But if he finds his eye, we might all die. But death isn't as scary as it used to be. Zito's darling Ragar is gone now!'
Kelliark nodded.

"...The person who will go to the mortal world to find Zito's eyes is obvious. The First Sword, Phaelito. Or the ones following him, Ridolros and Videluche. Perhaps Zito might send all three of them at once."
Sep spoke.

Those three were indeed the strongest demons in the underworld. Although only Phaelito was known to have reached the pinnacle of the underworld, it was the mainstream opinion that the other two were almost equal to him.
"If Zito, that bastard, really cared about the underworld, he would have led those three on the battlefield from the start. If they were there, so many demons wouldn't have died like dust."
"But if all three participate at once, can the mortal world protect the eyes? Even if only two go, it would be difficult."

"No, no. Having fought, the mortals are not ordinary either. If the superhuman leaders of each faction in the mortal world gather, even the three won't stand a chance, right? Not only those who attacked the castle in Grosh, but also Elona Zipple. It is a person who once sent me to the hospital, but my friend Kelliark expects him to be stronger than Phaelito."
"It's an unbelievable yet trustful story. Lord Kelliark's assessment will be accurate, but no matter how off-guard that person was, he was defeated by you."
"Ah, if you don't believe it, ask Elona Zipple when you meet him later. Rella, no matter what you do, you won't be able to hurt Elona Zipple as much as I did. Tsk."

"Of course, as Ragar said, the mortal world is strong. But when Zito sends the three Great Demon Kings to the Kingdom, he will definitely form a rift throughout the mortal world. While many major demon kings and generals have died, there are still billions of troops in the underworld, so he will ensure that all the mortal forces cannot concentrate on those three."

"In my opinion, it is so. Zito will release more rifts into the mortal world than ever before. Depending on whether the mortal world can defend Zito's eyes, the situation of the Great Demon War will completely change."
"Friend Kelliark, so we will move flexibly depending on the result?"
"That's right."
"Zito regaining his eyes, or not regaining his eyes. Which is a better picture for us?"
Instead of answering, Kelliark smiled.
He didn't care either way.
"Let's stop here for today, we have plenty of time to discuss. Reldro and Sep, you may leave now."
"Understood."
"So, we should keep trying to contact other demon kings until the next call?"
"Do that. The more the demon kings wake up from their brainwashing, the more it will help."
The Flame of Awakening.
The demon kings had faith in Kelliark's power to partially remove Zito's brainwashing. This power, like the seal of fire, bestowed absolute trust.
However, Kelliark had no intention of fully applying the Flame of Awakening to all the demon kings that Reldrow and Sep would bring in the future.
The reason Kelliark sought the demon kings was solely to examine the souls they possessed. He aimed to find a useful being among those souls, like the old Zipple or Kidadhol.
The two demon kings left.
"Lord Kelliark."
"Speak, Raela Belgasium."
"My lord. No, I'm worried about Lord Phaelito."
"Do you fear he might not return alive from the invasion of the Holy Land?"
"You are still at the stage of creation, or 'Gikma' in your language. It seems you don't understand the beings that reached that realm."

"I'm well aware that a demon who has reached 'Gikma' has power equal to or even surpassing a god. But Lord Phaelito is, like me not long ago, in a state of brainwashing. His abilities are diminished in all aspects, both in strength and mind."
"So, you're wondering if I have a way to help him."
"Yes."
"I was planning to meet him now anyway."
A sparkle appeared in Raela's eyes.
"Can you use the Flame of Awakening on Lord Phaelito as well?"
"I can't be certain until I meet him in person. Since he was originally at 'Gikma', it's likely that Zito put a lot of effort into brainwashing him, and my power might not work immediately."
"Ah......I see."
"However, even if he doesn't realize he's been brainwashed, I can provide him with a safety mechanism."
"A safety mechanism?"
Soon, Kelliark rose from his seat and looked down at Raela.
"Let's go to Phaelito together now, Raela. Right now, he won't meet me unless he has a guarantor like you. He'd meet me if I take drastic measures, but that's not the right approach."
